locator: Results 3.1 paragraph 3 and paragraph 5
printed_value: Cue (cue.v2.pt) did not detect events smaller than 5 kb, which the authors give as the lower limit of its training model.

locator: Methods 2.5
printed_value: HS-F removes calls under 500 bp or over 10 Mb, junction-only calls over 1 Mb, calls overlapping centromere or telomere gaps, and calls with >=90% reciprocal overlap with recurrent artifacts, using RTG vcffilter with a custom JavaScript.

locator: Results 3.7 paragraph 4; Discussion paragraph 3
printed_value: Manta and CNVnator were used to generate the NA12878 truth CNV set, so their calls may be favoured.
